newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: No escalation clause in IPCL's bid for NZ's W&H.
newsitem.headline: No escalation clause in IPCL's bid for NZ's W&H.

text.p: Broker BZW New Zealand Ltd on Thursday confirmed that its stand in the market for all shares in Wilson and Horton on behalf of Independent Press Communications (IPCL) did not include an escalation clause provision.

However, it said IPCL confirmed last week that Wilson and Horton shareholders accepting the written offer of NZ$11/share would receive the highest price paid by IPCL irrespective of the date on which they accept the offer.
IPCL is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Independent Newspapers Plc.

Independent's finance director James Parkinson on Thursday said the company had no intention of raising the offer price at present. He said although Independent was bidding for all of Wilson and Horton, it would be happy with less than 100 percent control. -- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
